report: A delivery vehicle backed toward the dock as an employee stepped into the travel lane. The employee stopped before entering the vehicle path. Temporary storage near the corner reduced driver visibility.
A rolling cart nearly struck an employee exiting a doorway. Staff reported the hallway had become congested during a recent workspace change.
A shelving unit shifted when an employee removed a box. No items fell. The employee reported that the rack had appeared uneven earlier in the week.
A second employee reported limited visibility where vehicles approach the loading dock. Temporary storage remained near the corner.
